title: Number Fusion
description: Engage your mind in strategic number merging! Slide matching quantum numbers together to fuse higher values, plan combos, use tactical undos, and aim for the 2048 singularity.
instructions: Swipe or use arrow keys to shift all numbers in one of 4 cardinal directions.
When two identical number tiles collide during a move, they fuse into their sum value.
A new tile (2 or 4) spawns after every valid shift.
Use your 3 tactical UNDO charges if you make an accidental move!
controls: U Key / Undo Button: Revert last move (up to 3 uses)
